_comment: Justifications for entries in package.json `overrides`. package.json is JSON
and cannot carry comments, so the reasoning lives here and scripts/audit-overrides.mjs
1. An override whose package is absent from the resolved tree is DEAD and must
be deleted. A dead override protects nothing and outlives the reason it was
added, which is how this block reached 29 entries.
2. An EXACT pin (no ^ or ~) must be justified here. Exact pins are the
dangerous kind: an override added to fix one CVE becomes the thing blocking
the fix for the next one. `semver` sat pinned at 7.6.3 while 7.8.5 shipped —
nine releases of fixes we had opted out of without deciding to.
Default to a caret range. Reach for an exact pin only when a newer in-major
release is known to break something, and say what.

sanitize-html.reason: Coupled to the htmlparser2 CJS hold. sanitize-html >= 2.17.6 delegates to htmlparser2, and the 10.x line is ESM-only; Jest cannot parse it ('Cannot use import statement outside a module') and the whole cmsSanitize suite dies. The `htmlparser2: ^9.1.0` override keeps the CJS 9.x line, and these two must move together. Lifting this means adding a Babel transform to the test toolchain, which is a deliberate piece of work, not a dependency chore. See PR #60.
